protocol.summary: Three daisy-chained addressable SK6812 RGB LEDs on the yellow data wire. The official RGBUnit delegates to SK6812; a model must decode the guest pulse stream instead of accepting a host-side color as guest output. protocol.summary: Three daisy-chained addressable SK6812 RGB LEDs on the yellow data wire. The official RGBUnit delegates to SK6812; a model must decode the guest pulse stream instead of accepting a host-side color as guest output. Verified SK6812 driver has ORDER=(1,0,2,3), bpp=3 and timing=1: the RGB variant transmits GRB byte order.
gaps: The schematic exposes a chain DOUT on one connector while the current product PinMap labels white NC; preserve connector-specific uncertainty.
